identity.operation: Read supported compressed ancillary metadata after IDAT through png_read_end.
identity.condition: A PNG contains supported compressed ancillary metadata after IDAT.
identity.capability: png_read_end reaches an accepting handler that calls png_decompress_chunk.
identity.consequence: The late metadata is not decompressed.

requirement: Reach the same supported decompression of compressed ancillary metadata after IDAT when reading a PNG to its end.

assessment.necessity_reason: A post-IDAT zTXt handler can call png_decompress_chunk, but whether that handler is enabled and reached by this old harness is unresolved. The harness calls png_start_read_image after png_read_update_info; whether the intervening call preserves the row-init flag, and whether the resulting application error is fatal, are decisive.

before.requirement: For a supported PNG containing compressed ancillary metadata after IDAT, png_read_end must reach an accepting handler and decompress that metadata.
before.reason: png_read_info stops at IDAT, and the zTXt handler permits processing after IDAT and calls png_decompress_chunk. The effective configuration, png_read_end dispatch, and effect of the harness's intervening calls are not established.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: png_read_info leaves chunks after IDAT for later reading.
png_read_update_info initializes row reading before the harness's later png_start_read_image call.
A subsequent png_start_read_image call reports an application error if the row-init flag remains set.
The application error warns or terminates according to PNG_FLAG_APP_ERRORS_WARN.

after.requirement: For a supported PNG containing compressed ancillary metadata after IDAT, png_read_end must reach an accepting handler and decompress that metadata.
after.reason: The after-source zTXt handler still calls png_decompress_chunk for compressed text after IDAT. The same unresolved configuration and call-path facts prevent a definite assessment of the old harness.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: png_read_info still leaves chunks after IDAT for later reading.
png_read_update_info still initializes row reading before the later png_start_read_image call.
The later call still reports an application error if the row-init flag remains set.
The error's effect still depends on PNG_FLAG_APP_ERRORS_WARN.

harness_evidence.dependency_reason: The recipe fixes the build whose compressed-text options must be resolved.

assessment.comparison_reason: Both sides have the same old harness call sequence and a zTXt-to-decompression path. A concrete blocker cannot be identified on either side until the configuration, png_read_end dispatch, intervening interlace call, and application-error default are known.
missing_information: Complete before and after png_read_end bodies to establish dispatch to post-IDAT zTXt or compressed iTXt handlers.
Complete before and after png_set_interlace_handling bodies to determine whether it changes PNG_FLAG_ROW_INIT between png_read_update_info and png_start_read_image.
Before and after read-structure initialization of PNG_FLAG_APP_ERRORS_WARN to determine whether the duplicate-call error terminates the read.
Effective compressed-text feature definitions from scripts/pnglibconf.dfa and configure.ac under the supplied recipe.

necessity_evidence.reason: The frozen obligation concerns compressed metadata after IDAT. The supplied zTXt handler supports that placement and calls png_decompress_chunk, and the harness calls png_read_end. The packet does not establish whether this build enables compressed text or whether the harness reaches that handler. The duplicate initialization may also stop the read, but its effect is unresolved. No blocked behavior or equivalent route is established.

scope_contract.reason: Reading through png_read_end is within the target’s PNG read surface, and zTXt accepts post-IDAT placement. Whether compressed-text reading is enabled by the supplied build remains unknown.

evidence.dependency_reason: The recipe fixes the configuration that determines whether the compressed-text handler is built.

feasible_trigger.reason: A finite PNG could contain compressed zTXt after IDAT, but the packet does not establish enabled support or that the old harness reaches png_read_end for it.

evidence.dependency_reason: png_read_update_info starts row reading before the harness calls png_start_read_image.
Row initialization sets PNG_FLAG_ROW_INIT, which controls the later duplicate-call check.
png_start_read_image reports an application error if that flag remains set.

observable_consequence.reason: There is no established loss of late metadata: the effect of the duplicate-call error and png_read_end’s dispatch are unresolved.

evidence.dependency_reason: png_app_error warns or errors according to PNG_FLAG_APP_ERRORS_WARN; the flag’s initialized value is not supplied.

alternatives_ruled_out.reason: The fixed harness shows no explicit alternate end-reading sequence. Pre-IDAT text would not satisfy this post-IDAT tuple, and post-IDAT iCCP is rejected. Whether the natural png_read_end route succeeds remains unresolved.

evidence.dependency_reason: The iCCP handler rejects an iCCP chunk after IDAT, so it is not a witness for this obligation.
The zTXt handler supplies a possible natural route, conditional on configuration and end-reading dispatch.

identity_preserved.reason: The same old harness and the same post-IDAT compressed-metadata tuple are assessed before and after. The zTXt path to png_decompress_chunk appears on both sides; this does not establish whether either side is blocked.

evidence.dependency_reason: The before-source zTXt handler accepts post-IDAT placement and calls the decompressor.
The after-source zTXt handler retains that path.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: The before-source handler permits late zTXt and calls png_decompress_chunk.
The after-source handler permits late zTXt and calls png_decompress_chunk.

harness_evidence.dependency_reason: The recipe determines the effective library configuration.

missing_information: The before and after bodies of png_read_end, including dispatch to post-IDAT zTXt and iTXt handlers.
The before and after bodies of png_set_interlace_handling, to determine whether it changes PNG_FLAG_ROW_INIT.
The initialized value of PNG_FLAG_APP_ERRORS_WARN for a read structure under this build.
The effective PNG_READ_COMPRESSED_TEXT_SUPPORTED, PNG_READ_zTXt_SUPPORTED, and PNG_READ_iTXt_SUPPORTED definitions under the supplied recipe.

coverage_witness.supported_behavior: Decompress supported zTXt or compressed iTXt metadata located after IDAT while reading to IEND, if enabled by the supplied build.
coverage_witness.required_setup: A valid PNG with post-IDAT compressed text, enabled compressed-text reading, completed image rows, and png_read_end dispatch to its handler.
coverage_witness.actual_target_setup: The old harness calls png_read_update_info, then png_set_interlace_handling and png_start_read_image, reads rows, and calls png_read_end.
coverage_witness.blocked_behavior: Unproven: the packet does not establish that late compressed metadata is unreachable.
coverage_witness.equivalent_routes: A pre-IDAT chunk does not satisfy the post-IDAT tuple; post-IDAT iCCP is rejected. Whether the harness’s natural png_read_end route succeeds is unknown.
